hero.eyebrow: Zhuoheng Li · M.S. Management & Analytics, NYU
hero.title: From the seven strings of the guqin to the metrics behind a product.
hero.subtitle: I trained as a guqin performer, then moved into business analytics. Along the way I built Lingxian, a notation editor that musicians use today. I like turning a messy domain into a clear product and a clear set of numbers.

analytics.title: E-commerce user & marketing analytics
analytics.question: Which users are worth more marketing spend, and which are about to churn?
analytics.method: Built a KPI system (UV/PV, funnel conversion, retention, repurchase) and cohort datasets with consistent metric definitions; segmented users with RFM + K-means.
analytics.output: High-value and churn-risk segments with per-segment marketing and ad recommendations.

analytics.title: Operations & product-selection analytics
analytics.question: Which products and categories deserve shelf space, and where are the anomalies?
analytics.method: Integrated data from several business systems into a product-selection metric framework: sales volume, revenue, growth, conversion, refund rate.
analytics.output: A daily operations brief for fast decisions and a list of category-level anomalies for the business to act on.

analytics.title: Social networks & starting salary
analytics.question: Does social-network use relate to graduates' starting salaries?
analytics.method: Cleaned and recoded survey data, handled missing values; descriptive statistics, group comparison and correlation analysis.
analytics.output: Charts and a written conclusion for a team report and class presentation.

miniProjects.title: Dynamic web crawler
miniProjects.body: Streamlit + Selenium tool that scrapes infinite-scroll pages, extracts fields by XPath/CSS/regex and lands them in MySQL or Excel.

miniProjects.title: Meteor Madness — NASA Space Apps 2025
miniProjects.body: Asteroid-impact simulator on NASA open data. I led the Prediction module: API integration and the 2D map that replaced the 3D globe for stability.

miniProjects.title: Client sites: WebDesigner, DeepEvol
miniProjects.body: Two marketing sites delivered for clients — a web-design studio and a research-tools startup — from brief to deployed Vercel site.

bullets: Cleaned, aggregated and analyzed business logs and operations data with Python (Pandas/NumPy) and SQL, processing 100,000+ structured records.
Built and maintained the core KPI system (activity, conversion, retention) and standardized metric definitions.
Produced weekly and monthly reports in Tableau and Excel, monitoring trends and anomalies for product and operations decisions.
Optimized key SQL queries (indexing and query structure), cutting runtime by about 20%.
Worked with product and operations teams to turn findings into actionable recommendations.

honors: Excellence Award (Professional Division), Shaanxi Provincial Traditional Instrument Exhibition (2024)
